name: Daiichi Kigenso Kagaku Kogyo Co., Ltd.
summary: Daiichi Kigenso Kagaku Kogyo Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of chemical industrial products in Japan, North America, Europe, East Asia, and South and Central Asia. The company provides zirconium oxide, electromelting stabilized zirconium oxide, complex oxide, zirconium compounds, cesium flux wires, rings, zirconium silicate, various sol, and non-oxide zirconium products, as well as oxides for electrolytes; and zirconia for advanced ceramics and solid oxide fuel cells. It also provides other inorganic compounds, including cesium compounds and rare earth compounds.
